Hash tables, binary variables, regular expression identifiers, hashes and encodings.
-- origin --
spec
-- script.mrc --
alias test {
  hmake t 10
  hadd t apple red
  hadd t banana yellow
  hinc t count 5
  hinc t count
  echo -s h: $hget(t, apple) $hget(t, count) $hget(t, 0).item $hget(t, 2).item $hget(t, 2).data
  echo -s h: $hfind(t, b*, 1, w) $hfind(t, *e*, 0, w).data $hget(t).size
  hdel t apple
  echo -s h: $hget(t, 0).item $iif($hget(t, apple) == $null,deleted)
  hfree t
  echo -s h: $iif($hget(t) == $null,freed)
  bset -t &b 1 hello
  bset &b -1 33
  echo -s b: $bvar(&b, 0) $bvar(&b, 1, 3) $bvar(&b, 1, 6).text $bfind(&b, 1, llo)
  echo -s r: $regex(abc123def, /(\d+)/) $regml(1) $regml(1).pos
  echo -s r: $regex(x, a1b22c333, /(\d+)/g) $regml(x, 0) $regml(x, 3)
  echo -s r: $regsubex(hello world, /(\w+)/g, $upper(\1)) $regsubex(abc, /b/, [\t])
  echo -s r: $regsub(aaa, /a/g, b, %out) %out
  echo -s c: $md5(abc) $sha1(abc) $crc(abc,0)
  echo -s e: $encode(hello, m) $decode(aGVsbG8=, m) $encode(münchen, y) $decode(mnchen-3ya, y)
  echo -s e: $decode($encode(round trip, u), u) $encode(a b/c, x)
}
-- output --
h: red 6 3 banana yellow
h: banana 2 10
h: 2 deleted
h: freed
b: 6 104 101 108 hello! 3
r: 1 123 4
r: 3 3 333
r: HELLO WORLD a[b]c
r: 3 bbb
c: 900150983cd24fb0d6963f7d28e17f72 a9993e364706816aba3e25717850c26c9cd0d89d 352441C2
e: aGVsbG8= hello mnchen-3ya münchen
e: round trip a%20b%2Fc
